description: This file defines the FilterAdapter class, a RecyclerView adapter for displaying and selecting filter options in a side navigation menu within an Android TV application. It manages filter items, updates their display, and handles user interactions.

classes.name: FilterAdapter
classes.description: RecyclerView adapter for displaying filter options, managing their selection state, and handling click events.

classes.name: FilterViewHolder
classes.description: ViewHolder class for filter items, binds filter data to UI and handles item click events.

classes.name: FilterItem
classes.description: Data class representing a single filter option with a display label and filter type.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates a new ViewHolder by inflating the item_filter layout.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds the filter item data to the ViewHolder and sets the selection state.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the number of filter items.

methods.name: updateCuisines
methods.description: Updates the filter list with new cuisine options and default filters.

methods.name: updateSelectedFilter
methods.description: Updates the currently selected filter and refreshes the UI.
